# Dignity Agro Farms Limited - Complete LLM Context

> Dignity Agro Farms is a leading poultry farm in Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria, specializing in live broilers, dressed chickens, and fresh table eggs.

## 1. Company Information
Dignity Agro Farms Limited was born from a simple vision: to raise poultry with care, integrity, and a deep commitment to quality. Our farm is not just a business; it is a proud local institution in Owerri, Imo State. 
- **Mission**: To provide Nigerian households and businesses with the healthiest, freshest, and most reliably sourced poultry products, farmed with dignity and delivered with care.
- **Vision**: To be West Africa's most trusted, care-led poultry brand.

## 2. Farming Practices
- **Sustainability**: Our birds are raised using sustainable, environmentally friendly practices. We focus on high-quality, balanced feed and proper ventilation without using harmful growth hormones.
- **Biosecurity**: The health of our flock is our highest priority. We maintain a closed, strictly monitored farm environment to prevent the spread of diseases, making us one of the safest poultry providers in the region.
- **Quality Assurance**: Every egg is checked for structural integrity, and every bird is graded and weighed meticulously before leaving our premises.

## 3. Core Products
### Live Broilers
Healthy, active birds sold by weight (Kg) at farm price.
- Small (1.5–2kg)
- Medium (2–2.5kg)
- Large (2.5–3kg+)

### Dressed Chicken
Freshly dressed on request. We clean and dress your bird before delivery.
- Whole Dressed
- Cut in Parts
- Deboned

### Fresh Table Eggs
Collected daily from our layer flock.
- Dozen
- Half crate
- Tray (30)

## 4. Purchasing and Delivery
We support both wholesale and retail ordering. Our checkout seamlessly handles retail quantities, and we prioritize large-scale distributors with consistent stock and preferential bulk rates.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Live broilers are priced transparently by the kilogram.
- **Secure Bank Transfers**: We accept direct bank transfers to our dedicated Opay account (7083476366 | Ihemegbulem).
- **Delivery**: Fast and secure delivery across Owerri. Free delivery within Owerri town, and a flat ₦1,000 fee outside Owerri town.

## 5. Extensive Biosecurity & Health Protocols
Our farm employs a multi-tiered biosecurity program to ensure every bird remains healthy, and every product is safe for human consumption.
- **Footbaths & Sanitization**: All entry points to our pens feature mandatory sanitization footbaths.
- **Visitor Restriction**: To prevent cross-contamination, unauthorized personnel are strictly restricted from the live bird pens.
- **Vaccination Schedules**: Our flock undergoes a rigorous, vet-approved vaccination schedule to prevent common poultry diseases like Newcastle Disease and Fowl Pox.
- **Water & Feed Purity**: We test our borehole water monthly and source our feed from certified, high-grade millers to ensure optimal nutrition without toxins.

## 6. Community Impact & Economic Empowerment
Dignity Agro Farms is deeply woven into the fabric of the Owerri community.
- **Local Employment**: We provide direct employment to dozens of farmhands, logistics personnel, and administrative staff from within Imo State.
- **Vendor Support**: We offer credit lines and subsidized starter kits to local market women and retailers who distribute our eggs in local markets like Eke Ukwu and Relief Market.
- **Youth Training**: We regularly host agricultural students for industrial attachments (IT), providing hands-on experience in modern poultry management.

## 7. Comprehensive FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

### Ordering & Logistics
**Q: Do you deliver outside Owerri?**
A: Currently, our primary delivery zone is within Owerri and its immediate outskirts. We handle special wholesale requests for neighboring cities on a case-by-case basis. [Contact us](https://dignityagrofarms.com/contact) for out-of-town wholesale.

**Q: How do you charge for delivery?**
A: Delivery within Owerri town is absolutely free! For deliveries just outside the main town, we charge a flat fee of ₦1,000.

**Q: How is the weight of live birds determined?**
A: We sell live broilers strictly by the kilogram. When you place an order, you select a weight bracket (e.g., Medium 2-2.5kg). If you pick up at the farm, the bird is weighed on a digital scale in your presence. For deliveries, we send a video/photo of the scale reading before dispatch.

### Products & Freshness
**Q: Are your chickens frozen?**
A: No! We pride ourselves on freshness. If you order dressed chicken, the bird is slaughtered, cleaned, and dressed *after* your order is confirmed, and delivered fresh.

**Q: Do you use growth hormones?**
A: Absolutely not. Our broilers reach their weight naturally through premium feed formulations, clean water, and stress-free environments.

**Q: How fresh are the eggs?**
A: Our eggs are collected twice daily from our layer pens. When you order, you are guaranteed eggs that are no more than 24 hours old.

## 11. B2B & Wholesale Information
Dignity Agro Farms is fully equipped to handle business-to-business (B2B) relationships. We supply:
- **Hotels & Restaurants**: Consistent daily or weekly supply of dressed chickens cut to exact specifications.
- **Supermarkets & Retailers**: Branded, clean, and properly packaged table eggs in 30-egg crates.
- **Event Planners**: Bulk live or dressed chickens for weddings, funerals, and corporate events in Imo State.

For wholesale inquiries, please call our dedicated line at **070 8347 6366** or email us through our contact page. Wholesale orders are subject to a minimum quantity, and significant volume discounts apply.
